sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Customer
SELECT Name FROM Genre ORDER BY Name ASC
SELECT MAX(UnitPrice) FROM Track
SELECT COUNT(CustomerId) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'
SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent'
SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice
SELECT T1.Title FROM Album AS T1 JOIN Track AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId WHERE T2.Name LIKE '%Greatest%'
SELECT AVG(T1.Milliseconds / 60) FROM Track AS T1 JOIN PlaylistTrack AS T2 ON T1.TrackId = T2.TrackId
SELECT T2.Name FROM Track AS T1 JOIN PlaylistTrack AS T2 ON T1.TrackId = T2.TrackId WHERE T1.Milliseconds > 20 * 60000
SELECT T2.Name, COUNT(T1.TrackId) FROM Genre AS T1 JOIN Track AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId GROUP BY T1.Name
SELECT T2.Name FROM Artist AS T1 JOIN Album AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId GROUP BY T1.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.Country, SUM(T1.Total) AS Revenue
FROM InvoiceLine AS T1
JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId
GROUP BY T2.Country
ORDER BY Revenue DESC
LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE YEAR(InvoiceDate) = 2023

SELECT YEAR(InvoiceDate) AS Year, SUM(Total) AS TotalRevenue
FROM Invoice
GROUP BY YEAR(InvoiceDate)
ORDER BY Year
SELECT Title FROM Album WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM Artist WHERE Name = 'AC/DC')
SELECT T2.Name FROM Album AS T1 JOIN PlaylistTrack AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId WHERE T1.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'
SELECT T2.Name, COUNT(T1.MediaTypeId) FROM MediaType AS T1 JOIN PlaylistTrack AS T2 ON T1.MediaTypeId = T2.MediaTypeId GROUP BY T1.Name
SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo = (SELECT EmployeeId FROM Employee WHERE FirstName = 'Nancy' AND LastName = 'Edwards')
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId
SELECT PlaylistId, Name FROM Playlist WHERE PlaylistId IN (SELECT PlaylistId FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY PlaylistId HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000)

SELECT T2.Name, AVG(T1.UnitPrice) AS AveragePrice
FROM Track AS T1
JOIN Genre AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId
GROUP BY T2.Name
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Composer FROM Track AS T1 JOIN PlaylistTrack AS T2 ON T1.TrackId = T2.TrackId GROUP BY T1.Composer HAVING COUNT(T2.TrackId) > 20

SELECT T2.Name, SUM(T1.UnitPrice * T2.Quantity) AS Revenue
FROM InvoiceLine AS T1
JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId
WHERE T1.TrackId IN (
    SELECT T3.TrackId
    FROM PlaylistTrack AS T3
    JOIN Playlist AS T4 ON T3.PlaylistId = T4.PlaylistId
    WHERE T4.Name = 'Audiobooks'
)
GROUP BY T2.Name
ORDER BY Revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT a.Name, COUNT(il.TrackId) AS TracksSold
FROM Artist a
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON a.ArtistId = il.ArtistId
GROUP BY a.ArtistId
ORDER BY TracksSold DESC
LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.FirstName, T1.LastName FROM Customer AS T1 JOIN InvoiceLine AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId JOIN Track AS T3 ON T2.TrackId = T3.TrackId WHERE T3.Name = 'Jazz'

SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, SUM(i.Total * l.UnitPrice) AS Revenue
FROM Employee e
JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON c.CustomerId = il.CustomerId
JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
JOIN MediaType m ON i.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
JOIN Playlist p ON i.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId
WHERE p.Name IN ('Audiobooks', 'Movies')
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName
SELECT COUNT(T1.TrackId) FROM InvoiceLine AS T1 JOIN Track AS T2 ON T1.TrackId = T2.TrackId WHERE T1.Quantity = 0

SELECT T1.Title, CAST(T1.Total / 60 AS INT) AS Minutes
FROM Album AS T1
JOIN InvoiceLine AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId
GROUP BY T1.AlbumId
ORDER BY SUM(T2.UnitPrice) DESC
LIMIT 5
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Name FROM Artist AS T1 JOIN Genre AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING COUNT(T2.GenreId) > 1
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Total > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.TrackId) FROM Track AS T1 INNER JOIN InvoiceLine AS T2 ON T1.TrackId = T2.TrackId
SELECT FirstName, LastName, HireDate FROM Employee ORDER BY HireDate DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Customer WHERE CustomerId IN (SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) > (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Invoice))

SELECT YEAR(InvoiceDate) AS Year, Genre.Name AS GenreName, SUM(InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS QuantitySold
FROM Invoice
JOIN InvoiceLine ON Invoice.InvoiceId = InvoiceLine.InvoiceId
JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId
GROUP BY YEAR(InvoiceDate), Genre.Name
ORDER BY YEAR(InvoiceDate) ASC

SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', DATE_TRUNC('month', BillingDate)) AS Month,
    SUM(Total) AS MonthlyRevenue
FROM 
    Invoice
WHERE 
    BillingDate >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
GROUP BY 
    strftime('%Y-%m', DATE_TRUNC('month', BillingDate))
ORDER BY 
    strftime('%Y-%m', DATE_TRUNC('month', BillingDate))

SELECT T2.Name, CAST(SUM(T3.UnitPrice * T3.Quantity) AS REAL) / SUM(T3.UnitPrice) * 100 AS Percentage
FROM InvoiceLine AS T1
JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId
JOIN MediaType AS T3 ON T1.MediaTypeId = T3.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY T2.Name
SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE YEAR(i.InvoiceDate) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025 GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY COUNT(c.CustomerId) DESC

SELECT FirstName, LastName, ManagerFirstName, ManagerLastName FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', t.InvoiceDate) AS Month, SUM(t.Total) AS Revenue
FROM InvoiceLine t
JOIN Invoice i ON t.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
WHERE strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) = '2022'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', t.InvoiceDate)
ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', t.InvoiceDate);
SELECT T2.Name FROM Playlist AS T1 JOIN PlaylistTrack AS T2 ON T1.PlaylistId = T2.PlaylistId WHERE T2.TrackId IS NULL
SELECT count(*) FROM countries
SELECT name FROM countries WHERE region = 'South Asia'
SELECT capital_city FROM countries WHERE iso3 = 'JP'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries WHERE income_group = 'Low income'
SELECT population FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = 'India' AND year = 2023
SELECT name, population FROM countries ORDER BY population DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT income_group, COUNT(*) FROM country_stats GROUP BY income_group
SELECT name FROM countries WHERE iso3 = (SELECT iso3 FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023 ORDER BY gdp_per_capita_usd DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT SUM(population) AS combined_population, YEAR FROM countries GROUP BY YEAR ORDER BY YEAR
SELECT T1.name FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2023 AND T2.life_expectancy_years > 70
SELECT T2.unemployment_pct FROM countries AS T1 INNER JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T1.name = 'Germany' AND T2.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2023 ORDER BY T2.year

SELECT T1.region, AVG(T2.fertility_rate) AS average_fertility_rate
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3
WHERE T2.year = 2023
GROUP BY T1.region
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries WHERE income_group = 'High income' AND gdp_usd > 10000000000
SELECT T1.name FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T1.region = 'Europe & Central Asia' AND T2.year = 2023 ORDER BY T2.fertility_rate ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT year, gdp_usd FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = 'USA' AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023
SELECT region FROM country_stats WHERE internet_users_pct > 70 AND year = 2023
SELECT SUM(population) - SUM(capital_city) FROM countries WHERE iso3 = 'China' AND YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023
SELECT name, gain FROM countries WHERE year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023 GROUP BY name ORDER BY gain DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT income_group, SUM(gdp_usd) AS total_gdp
FROM country_stats
WHERE year = 2023
GROUP BY income_group
ORDER BY total_gdp DESC
SELECT T1.name FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2023 AND T1.region = ( SELECT AVG(region) FROM countries )
SELECT AVG(T1.population * T2.life_expectancy_years) FROM countries AS T1 INNER JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2023
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries WHERE population < (SELECT population FROM countries WHERE year = 2023)
SELECT T1.name, T1.region, T1.life_expectancy_years FROM countries AS T1 INNER JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2023 AND T1.life_expectancy_years < 60
SELECT T1.region, CAST(SUM(T2.population) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(T2.population) FROM countries AS T1 INNER JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2023 GROUP BY T1.region
SELECT name FROM countries WHERE iso3 NOT IN (SELECT iso3 FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023)
SELECT T2.year, CAST(T2.gdp_per_capita_usd AS REAL) * 100 / T1.gdp_per_capita_usd FROM countries AS T1 INNER JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T1.name = 'France' ORDER BY T2.year
SELECT T1.income_group, T1.name, T2.gdp_per_capita_usd FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2023 ORDER BY T2.gdp_per_capita_usd DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT region, AVG(urban_population_pct) FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023 GROUP BY region ORDER BY AVG(urban_population_pct) DESC
SELECT T1.name FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2023 AND T2.internet_users_pct < 10 AND T2.internet_users_pct > 50

SELECT T1.gdp_per_capita_usd AS GDP_per_capita, T2.life_expectancy_years AS Life_expectancy
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3
WHERE T2.year = 2023
SELECT T1.region, T1.name, T1.population FROM countries AS T1 INNER JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2023 ORDER BY T1.population DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.region, T1.name, T2.unemployment_rate FROM countries AS T1 INNER JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2020 ORDER BY T2.unemployment_rate DESC

SELECT T2.region, T2.year, AVG(T1.life_expectancy_years) AS avg_life_expectancy
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3
GROUP BY T2.region, T2.year
SELECT count(*) FROM penguins
SELECT COUNT(species) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'Gentoo'
SELECT DISTINCT island FROM penguins
SELECT body_mass_g FROM penguins ORDER BY body_mass_g DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE sex IS NULL
SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins
SELECT species, COUNT(*) FROM penguins GROUP BY species
SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g) FROM penguins GROUP BY species

SELECT island, year, COUNT(*) AS num_penguins
FROM penguins
GROUP BY island, year
SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm) AS male_avg_bill_length, AVG(bill_length_mm) AS female_avg_bill_length FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'male' OR sex = 'female'
SELECT species FROM penguins GROUP BY species ORDER BY avg(flipper_length_mm) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT species, MIN(bill_depth_mm), MAX(bill_depth_mm) FROM penguins GROUP BY species
SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT species, sex, AVG(body_mass_g) FROM penguins WHERE sex != 'unknown' GROUP BY species, sex
SELECT species FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'male' AND body_mass_g = (SELECT body_mass_g FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'female') ORDER BY body_mass_g DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(species) FROM penguins WHERE bill_length_mm > (SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm) FROM penguins)
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN species = 'Gentoo' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE island = 'Biscoe'

SELECT species, year, COUNT(*) AS num_penguins
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species, year
ORDER BY species, year
SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island HAVING COUNT(species) > 1
SELECT species, island, body_mass_g FROM penguins ORDER BY body_mass_g DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_2007, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_2009 FROM penguins WHERE year = 2007 OR year = 2009 GROUP BY species
SELECT species, island FROM penguins WHERE flipper_length_mm > (SELECT avg(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins)
SELECT rank(), species, avg(bill_length_mm) FROM penguins ORDER BY avg(bill_length_mm) DESC
SELECT species, STDDEV(body_mass_g) FROM penguins GROUP BY species

SELECT FirstName, LastName, SUM(Total) AS TotalSpent
FROM Customer
GROUP BY CustomerId
ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC
LIMIT 3
